status: Illustrative planning assumptions; no quotes or commitments unless a source explicitly says advertised pricing.

sources_and_limits.storage_per_car: AutoKeep advertises $500/month for multiple indoor cars, checked 2026-11-08: https://www.theautokeep.com/ . Shared-club eligibility, availability and extra fees unconfirmed.
sources_and_limits.annual_entity_tax: California FTB LLC overview: https://www.ftb.ca.gov/file/business/types/limited-liability-company/index.html . $800 modeled only if an LLC is selected; other taxes/fees not determined.
sources_and_limits.all_other_costs: Unquoted planning inputs. Purchase allocations are ceilings, not vehicle appraisals or current market estimates. Initial management fee and monthly management are separate hypothetical payments, not approved compensation.
sources_and_limits.tax: 9% acquisition rate is a sensitivity placeholder. Actual jurisdiction, use classification, and tax on acquisition versus receipts require accountant confirmation; taxes on usage receipts are not modeled.
sources_and_limits.reserve: Repair contributions are earmarking of cash, not an external expense. Funding need includes saving this amount; total bank cash decreases only by external cash costs less revenue. Routine maintenance excludes major repairs covered by reserves.
sources_and_limits.mileage: 3000 annual miles per car is a planning scenario, not an insurer limit or forecast. Maintenance is a flat placeholder at this scenario's mileage; adjust costs with usage rather than treating extra miles as free.
sources_and_limits.excluded: Driver-paid fuel, depreciation/appreciation, capital opportunity cost, debt, major uninsured losses, usage taxes, unquoted lease deposits/fit-out, and professional fees beyond the placeholder allocations. Contingency is budgeted as spent; unspent contingency would improve cash. This is not a full economic return model.
